mentions.name: jank
mentions.description: The jank programming language, a native Clojure dialect that is also a C++ dialect, including a JIT compiler and nREPL server. A custom IR is being built to enable optimization passes at the level of Clojure semantics, which LLVM cannot perform at the LLVM IR level.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on the jank programming language!

https://github.com/jank-lang/jank

It's a native Clojure dialect which is also a C++ dialect, including a JIT compiler and nREPL server. I'm currently building out a custom IR so I can do optimization passes at the level of Clojure semantics, since LLVM will not be able to do them at the LLVM IR level.
